keywords: which side is the fuel tank

scenes.visual: illustration of a car dashboard close-up seen from the driver's seat, one round fuel gauge in the centre with its needle near empty, below the gauge a small white petrol pump icon with a tiny orange triangle arrow pointing right beside it, simple dark dashboard, the gauge in the lower two-thirds of the frame
scenes.narration: That tiny *arrow* by your fuel gauge? Ever wondered what it's pointing at?

scenes.visual: illustration of a young Indian man at a petrol pump, standing beside his small hatchback car, holding the fuel nozzle with a stretched hose that doesn't reach because the fuel lid is on the far side of the car, he looks annoyed with a half smile, simple petrol station background
scenes.narration: You pull up to the pump... and the fuel lid's on the *wrong* side. Again. Stick around, the fix is already in your car.
scenes.headline: WRONG *SIDE* AGAIN?

scenes.visual: 2D animation: a big fuel gauge, the needle falls while a counter drops from 100% to 15%, then a tiny triangle pops in next to the pump icon
scenes.narration: Here's the thing. When fuel runs *low*, you look down at the gauge. And right beside the little pump icon... there's a tiny *triangle*.
scenes.headline: LOOK *CLOSER*

scenes.visual: illustration of a car designer in a 1980s style raincoat standing at a petrol pump in heavy rain, soaked and shaking his head, an old boxy car parked with its fuel lid on the far side, simple rainy petrol station background
scenes.narration: But here's the weird part. It started with one fed-up designer at Ford, in nineteen eighty-six. Wrong side of the pump... in the *rain*.
scenes.headline: ONE *SOAKED* GUY

scenes.visual: 2D animation: a car seen from above with the dashboard arrow above it; the arrow points left and the left fuel lid glows, then it flips right and the right lid glows
scenes.narration: So he pushed for a tiny arrow on the dashboard. Arrow points *left*? Your fuel lid's on the left. Points right? It's on the right.
scenes.headline: LEFT OR *RIGHT*

scenes.visual: illustration of a smiling young Indian woman driver pulling her car up to a petrol pump on the correct side, the fuel lid right next to the pump, sunny simple petrol station background, side view
scenes.narration: And that tiny arrow? <short pause> It's your car telling you which side to pull up on. Most newer cars have one.
scenes.headline: IT'S A *HINT*
